config.selection: strategy C: model credit >= 0.45x width (both sides), pooled top-6/day by margin of victory M·e^(−k·D_ent) at k=24 (GROUND >= 0.0001); entries only once the name has 252 sessions of history (start 2020-10-06)
config.scoring: rank: M = mean margin of victory in sd units over the same 252-session window as P_real (how far each historical move finished past the strike), discounted M·e^(−k·D_ent), k = 24; gate: GROUND = (e^G−1)·e^(−k·D_ent) on Kelly growth at the delta-capped model credit
config.fill_basis: 1.00× min(smile-fit model credit, |short delta| × width, best quoted credit); quote gates: touch > 0, no crossed or inverted quotes, $0.50 strike ladder; partial-WIN at 50% intrinsic; no commission
config.regime: bull puts every day; bear calls only below the prior-session SPY 100d SMA
config.parity: no bull parity veto; no bear parity veto
config.bear_gates: bear calls: IV < 0.35, same credit floor, share the pooled top-6. Earnings, ex-dividend and corporate-action (split / reverse split / spinoff) gates, entry through expiry+1, apply to both sleeves.
config.window: 252 full sessions of realized DTE-matched moves vs the exact strikes (P_real, every trading day), drift-free: each name's window-mean return removed before counting
config.dkl: D_ent = D(Q_bs‖U₃) = ln3 − H(Q_bs), Q_bs = N(d2) at the smile-fit IVs (Mercurio–Wu–Xie 2020 eq. 19)
config.gap: P_real drift = 1 × β_year σ × z(the stock's OWN opening gap, ATR units) × √DTE; no market average
